message: objective and subjective conditions hold; no evaluation (R9 not applied)

target_user_groups: Researchers in finance and information systems
Entrepreneurs and investors in the DeFi sector
intended_purposes: Systematically structure the emerging field of decentralized finance by classifying DeFi applications
Analyze the DeFi landscape to identify patterns and opportunities for value propositions and business models
Support the design of regulatory measures
input.domain_of_objects: Decentralized finance (DeFi) applications: financial services built on smart contracts on public blockchains without intermediaries

meta_characteristic: DeFi applications viewed as financial services delivered by smart contracts on public blockchains without intermediaries, examined through the strategic, organizational, and technological means by which they create value and are structured.

dimensions.name: Primary financial service
dimensions.definition: The financial service that forms the core value proposition of the DeFi application, delivered by smart contracts without intermediaries.
dimensions.application_rule: Observe the financial service the application mainly offers to users. If several services apply, choose the first matching characteristic in this order: yield aggregation and optimization, lending and borrowing, trading and exchange, stablecoin issuance, staking and liquid staking, insurance, other financial service.

characteristics.name: Yield aggregation and optimization
characteristics.definition: The primary service routes or compounds users' funds across yield opportunities to generate returns.

characteristics.name: Lending and borrowing
characteristics.definition: The primary service lets users lend assets for interest or borrow assets against collateral.

characteristics.name: Trading and exchange
characteristics.definition: The primary service enables swaps or derivative trading of crypto assets.

characteristics.name: Stablecoin issuance
characteristics.definition: The primary service issues a stablecoin or a certificate-of-deposit token.

characteristics.name: Staking and liquid staking
characteristics.definition: The primary service lets users stake assets, often receiving tokens that represent the staked position.

characteristics.name: Insurance
characteristics.definition: The primary service provides cover against losses such as smart contract risks.

characteristics.name: Other financial service
characteristics.definition: The primary service is none of the above, such as prize-linked savings or NFT farming.

dimensions.name: Revenue model
dimensions.definition: How the DeFi application captures value from its activities for its owners or token holders.
dimensions.application_rule: Observe how the application generates and distributes revenue. If it shares revenue with token stakers, choose that characteristic. Otherwise, if it charges protocol fees, choose the fee characteristic. Otherwise, if it states that no protocol fee is charged, choose that characteristic. If no revenue information is given, choose the negation characteristic.

characteristics.name: Revenue shared with token stakers
characteristics.definition: Holders who stake the application's token receive part of the revenue collected by the application.

characteristics.name: Protocol fees retained by the application
characteristics.definition: The application charges performance, management, service or protocol fees that it keeps as revenue.

characteristics.name: No protocol fee charged
characteristics.definition: The application does not charge a protocol fee on its services by default.

characteristics.name: No revenue model described
characteristics.definition: The sources do not describe how the application generates or distributes revenue.

dimensions.name: Governance model
dimensions.definition: How decisions on the DeFi application and control over its smart contracts are made.
dimensions.application_rule: If decisions are made by holders of a governance token or the application is organized as a DAO, choose token-holder governance. If a project team or individuals control decisions or contract changes, choose team-controlled governance. If governance is not described, choose the negation characteristic.

characteristics.name: Token-holder governance
characteristics.definition: Decisions are made by holders of the application's governance token, for example through voting or as a DAO.

characteristics.name: Team-controlled governance
characteristics.definition: Decisions or contract changes rest with a project team or individuals rather than with token holders.

characteristics.name: Governance not described
characteristics.definition: The sources do not describe how decisions on the application are made.

dimensions.name: Platform scope
dimensions.definition: Whether the DeFi application is offered on its own or as one product within a larger platform or ecosystem.
dimensions.application_rule: If the application is described as a product, feature or component of a multi-product platform or ecosystem, choose that characteristic. Otherwise choose standalone application.

characteristics.name: Standalone application
characteristics.definition: The application is offered as a single application and is not described as part of a larger product platform or ecosystem.

characteristics.name: Product within a multi-product platform or ecosystem
characteristics.definition: The application is one of several products, features or components of a larger platform or DeFi ecosystem.

dimensions.name: Blockchain deployment
dimensions.definition: The number of public blockchains on which the DeFi application operates.
dimensions.application_rule: If the application is deployed on two or more public blockchains, choose multiple public blockchains. If it is deployed on exactly one public blockchain, choose single public blockchain. If the blockchain is not stated, choose the negation characteristic.

characteristics.name: Single public blockchain
characteristics.definition: The application operates on exactly one public blockchain.

characteristics.name: Multiple public blockchains
characteristics.definition: The application operates on two or more public blockchains.

characteristics.name: Blockchain not specified
characteristics.definition: The sources do not state on which public blockchain the application operates.

dimensions.name: Core mechanism
dimensions.definition: The technical mechanism through which the DeFi application executes its financial service in smart contracts.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the first matching characteristic in this order: automated market maker, order book or auction settlement, interest-rate lending market, vault-based strategy automation, other mechanism.

characteristics.name: Automated market maker
characteristics.definition: Trades or liquidity are priced from liquidity pools by an automated market maker formula rather than an order book.

characteristics.name: Order book or auction settlement
characteristics.definition: Trades are settled through an order book, batch auction, Dutch auction or intent-based execution by solvers or fillers.

characteristics.name: Interest-rate lending market
characteristics.definition: Deposited assets are lent in markets whose interest rates are set by supply and demand or by a rate mechanism.

characteristics.name: Vault-based strategy automation
characteristics.definition: User deposits are placed in smart contract vaults that automatically run yield strategies.

characteristics.name: Other mechanism
characteristics.definition: The application uses a mechanism not covered above, such as collateralized stablecoin loans, prize lotteries, insurance pools, liquid staking tokens or rebasing tokens.

dimensions.name: Role in the DeFi stack
dimensions.definition: Whether the DeFi application primarily aggregates or optimizes access to other DeFi protocols or provides its own primitive service.
dimensions.application_rule: If the application routes trades, deposits or funds to other protocols, or aggregates supply or demand across them, choose aggregator or optimizer. Otherwise choose primitive protocol.

characteristics.name: Aggregator or optimizer
characteristics.definition: The application routes trades, deposits or funds to other DeFi protocols or aggregates their liquidity to offer users better rates or returns.

characteristics.name: Primitive protocol
characteristics.definition: The application provides its own financial service on its own contracts and liquidity rather than mainly routing to other protocols.

details.O1: 84 objects, 7 dimensions; 0 objects not classified in every dimension
details.O2: objects are registered once and never merged or split
details.O5: not checked: only the e iterations after the first are checked
details.O7: no duplicate characteristic within a dimension

concise.justification: The taxonomy has seven dimensions across three perspectives, and each serves a stated purpose: classifying applications, identifying value-proposition and business-model patterns, and informing regulation. Some overlap between the primary service (D1) and core mechanism (D6) exists, but they capture different perspectives and do not make the taxonomy unnecessarily large.

robust.justification: The dimensions and characteristics split the objects into non-trivial groups with mutually exclusive, ordered application rules, so objects are distinguished well across the dimensions.

comprehensive.justification: Every object can be placed through the negation characteristics, and the few objects that fit no characteristic are minimal. Dimensions are present for strategy (D1, D2), organization (D3, D4) and technology (D5 to D7), which covers the purposes and target users, including governance for regulators.

extendible.justification: Negation characteristics such as 'Other financial service' and 'Other mechanism' allow new objects to be classified, and new dimensions or characteristics can be added to a perspective without restructuring the existing ones.

explanatory.justification: Each dimension and characteristic has a clear definition tied to the DeFi meta-characteristic of smart-contract financial services without intermediaries, and the definitions explain the nature of the applications with respect to the stated purpose.
